periods.label: Infant old-era survivor

status.condition: baby rescued from a New Kingdom ruins site

periods.summary: Silver-haired infant from the Arcadia clan survivors found by Ariel in a New Kingdom ruin. Airi temporarily watches her in the academy reception room before Ariel retrieves the survivors.

airi-arcadia.summary: Airi holds and soothes her in the prologue.

ariel-vi-arcadia.summary: Ariel found her among old-era survivors and will collect her.

lux-arcadia.summary: Airi's talk of a 'father' causes Noct to misunderstand.

key_events.summary: Appears as evidence that Ariel is finding and protecting Arcadia survivors in ruins.
